#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – [September 10, 2024, 11:32 AM]:**
  - Provided instructions for setting up participant and researcher accounts for the Avicenna app.
  - Shared Study ID (3950) and participant usernames.
  - Requested confirmation once researcher accounts are created to add them to the platform.
  - *Key quote:* "If you have troubles with setting up your accounts please contact sara@avicennaresearch.com and CC me."

- **[Paul McCrorie] (Role not specified, Glasgow University) – [September 13, 2024, 1:31 PM]:**
  - Reported issues with setting up the app, including buggy error messages and problems with email validation.
  - Used participant10 due to issues with participant3.
  - Mentioned issues with background app refresh settings.
  - *Key quote:* "Lot's of buggy error messages when trying to sign up, especially when entering the Study ID."

- **[Fiona Caryl] (Role not specified, Glasgow University) – [September 17, 2024, 10:46 AM]:**
  - Noted she was missed from the initial setup email.
  - Created participant (participant9) and researcher accounts.
  - Requested validation code and addition to project 3950.
  - *Key quote:* "I have downloaded the app and created account as participant9 – it’s asking for a validation code, if you could let me know this."

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – [September 17, 2024, 1:36 PM]:**
  - Responded to Fiona, clarifying that no validation code is needed in the testing phase.
  - Notified Fiona about the email verification requirement for researcher access.
  - *Key quote:* "I’ve just tried adding you as a researcher but I got a notification saying that ‘the person has not verified their email yet’."

- **[Sara Farnya] (Role not specified, Avicenna Research) – [September 17, 2024, After 1:36 PM]:**
  - Clarified the email verification requirement for participants and researchers.
  - Explained the purpose of email notifications in the sample study.
  - *Key quote:* "As researchers, verifying your email address is mandatory, so please make sure to complete this step."

- **[September 10, 2024]:** Magda sends initial instructions for app setup.
- **[September 13, 2024]:** Paul reports issues with app setup.
- **[September 17, 2024]:** Fiona requests validation code; Magda and Sara respond.

- **Issue 1:** Paul encountered buggy error messages during app setup, including issues with Study ID entry and email validation.
- **Feedback Submission:** Fiona noted missing initial setup email and requested validation code.
- **Access/Login Issues:** Magda couldn’t add Fiona as a researcher due to unverified email.

  - Magda to add Fiona as a researcher after email verification (assigned to Magda).
- **Completed:**
